sections.text_helper: Section 25.4.3 "EXTI multiplexer selection" in chapter 25 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1131.
sections.section_content:
The EXTI multiplexer is used to select GPIOs as interrupts and wake-up. The GPIOs are
connected via 16 EXTI multiplexers to the first 16 EXTI events as configurable event.
Theselection of GPIO port as EXTI multiplexer output is controlled by
EXTIn_EXTICRx(x=1 to 4) registers.
Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)
[Figure 158. EXTI mux GPIO selection]
